releaseNotes:
### What's New in v1.0.378:

• Fixed Abbreviations Expansion: Resolved an in-band annotation inversion issue (`da1` ON, `da0` OFF) that prevented abbreviations (such as 'Dr.', 'Mr.', 'St.') from being expanded by the speech engine.
• Protected Dotted Abbreviation Pauses: Ensured sentence boundary and pause processing does not split dotted abbreviations (e.g. 'Dr. Smith'), keeping tokens intact for the synthesizer dictionary.
• Longest-Match Dictionary Precedence: Multi-word dictionary entries at the same position now prioritize the longest match first (e.g. 'New York' over 'New').
• Special Symbols & Punctuation Alignment: Copyright (©), Registered (®), and Trademark (™) are now recognized as punctuation rather than emoji, respecting punctuation verbosity levels (silent under None, spoken from Some up).
• Plain Emoji Names: Cleaned up emoji readings to verbalize natural descriptions without the repetitive 'emoji' prefix and improved skin-tone modifier descriptions.
• Hardened OTA Update Pipeline: Verified, safe self-cleaning update downloader and installer with full FileProvider path compatibility across all Android versions.
